_note: Amounts are PENCE. 80 cards. Rules in Appendix A of money-game-spec.md. Run `npm run deck:check` after editing.
_variants: Both players get the SAME card on the same day — the comparison view depends on it. `variants` overrides the wording for one craft, keyed on the craft chosen at season start: crochet = Robin, baking = Sam. A craft with no variant falls back to the generic text.
_grounding: Home is Millbrook; the school bus runs Millbrook <-> Eastport. Coffee chains are beside school. Local shop is in Millbrook. Youth club is the Youth Club. Yarn is from The Wool Shop on High Street, Eastport. Robin: crochet, singing lessons, Brigade. Sam: baking (fancy, heavily decorated), violin lessons, kart games. Robin rollerblades at the roller rink; Sam skates at the ice rink. Lessons are parent-paid - only the extras fall to them.
_todo: Real family birthday cards were removed from this public copy. Add your own, with a `season_window`, to taste.

cards.title: Overtime Saturday
cards.body: Your manager texts: someone's called in sick and there's a full extra shift going Saturday. It's £30. It's also the afternoon everyone else is going to the cinema.

options.label: Take the shift
options.outcome: You work the shift. The photos go up about four.

options.label: Go to the cinema
options.outcome: You go. It's a good afternoon.

cards.title: Two evenings going
cards.body: There are two evening shifts available this week. £22 each. You have homework due Friday.

options.label: Take both (£44)
options.outcome: Taken. The homework happens on Thursday night.

options.label: Neither
options.outcome: Neither. The homework is actually good.

cards.title: Tips split
cards.body: The jar gets split at the end of the month and your share is £13.

cards.title: Burst pipe
cards.body: The shop's shut Saturday — a pipe went in the back. No shift, no pay.

options.label: Nothing you can do
options.outcome: Nothing you can do. It's a lean week.

cards.title: A fiver in a coat
cards.body: Last winter's coat, inside pocket. £5 you had entirely forgotten about.

cards.title: Someone wants to buy one
cards.body: Someone has seen something you made and offers £18 for one of their own.

options.label: Say you haven't time
options.outcome: You say you haven't time. Which is true, this week.

crochet.title: Can you make me one
crochet.body: Someone at church has seen the last thing you made and asks if you'd do one for their niece. They offer £18. It's maybe four evenings of work and you'd need more yarn.

options.label: Say yes (£18)
options.outcome: Agreed. Four evenings of it, and the yarn comes out of your own money first.

options.label: Say you haven't time
options.outcome: You say you haven't time. Which is true, this week.

baking.title: Could you do a cake
baking.body: Someone at church asks if you'd do a birthday cake — two tiers, the full decorating. They offer £18. The ingredients and the colours alone are most of a tenner.

options.label: Say yes (£18)
options.outcome: Agreed. You find out on Thursday what £18 actually covers.

options.label: Say you haven't time
options.outcome: You say you haven't time. Which is true, this week.

cards.title: SIM payment due
cards.body: £11 out for the SIM. It goes whether you look at it or not.

cards.title: Bus pass gone
cards.body: It's not in your coat, not in your bag, not in your room — and the Millbrook bus into Eastport is at ten past eight.

options.label: Buy a replacement (£14)
options.outcome: Replaced. Keep it somewhere sensible this time.

options.label: Pay on the bus for now (£10.50)
options.outcome: Three days of fares. It turns up on Thursday, in the coat.

cards.title: Youth Club weekend — balance due
cards.body: The balance for the youth weekend is due Friday. £25, and the form has been in your bag for a fortnight.

options.label: Don't go
options.outcome: You don't go. That's decided now, and everyone finds out on Sunday.

cards.title: Screen
cards.body: It went down the concrete steps face first. It still works, but it's spidered corner to corner.

options.label: Get it repaired (£45)
options.outcome: Repaired. That hurt.

options.label: Live with it
options.outcome: You live with it. It catches your thumb.

cards.title: Price change email
cards.body: The subscription is going from £5.99 to £6.99 next month. The email calls it an update.

options.label: Cancel it
options.outcome: Cancelled. You'll find out this week whether you miss it.

cards.title: The lesson is paid for. This isn't.
cards.body: Your lessons are covered at home. The extra that's come up this term isn't — £16.

options.label: Put it off
options.outcome: You put it off. Nobody makes you feel bad about it, which is somehow worse.

crochet.title: Exam entry
crochet.body: Your singing lessons are paid for at home. The exam entry fee is not, and it's £16, due before half term.

options.label: Sit it next session instead
options.outcome: You put it off a term. Nobody makes you feel bad about it, which is somehow worse.

baking.title: Strings
baking.body: Your violin lessons are paid for at home. A string went on Tuesday and a replacement set is £16 — you can't do this week's lesson without it.

options.label: Borrow a set for now
options.outcome: You borrow a set. You will have to replace them, and you both know it.

cards.title: Getting there
cards.body: There's a thing on Saturday you've committed to, and it's not somewhere the bus goes. £6 towards fuel for whoever's driving.

crochet.title: Brigade competition — Saturday
crochet.body: The competition is Saturday and it's an away one, so there's an early start, extra rehearsals this week, and £6 towards the minibus.

options.label: Chip in for the minibus (£6)
options.outcome: Paid. The rehearsals eat the week whether you like it or not.

cards.title: Lunch, again
cards.body: You forgot to make anything. You can get something in school for about £3.20, or get through the afternoon on what's in your bag.

options.label: Ride it out
options.outcome: A cereal bar and a long afternoon. Free, though.

cards.title: Starbucks after school
cards.body: Four of you head round to Starbucks and it has landed on you to get them in. £14 for the round, or £3.75 for your own.

options.label: Get the round (£14)
options.outcome: You get the round. It's noted.

options.label: Just yours (£3.75)
options.outcome: You get your own. It's also noted.

cards.title: Everyone's going to McDonald's
cards.body: Straight out the gate and round the corner. You're not hungry, particularly, but that's not really what it's about.

options.label: Just a drink (£1.50)
options.outcome: You sit in with a drink. Nobody notices or cares.

options.label: Get the bus home
options.outcome: You get the bus home. You're back before four.

cards.title: The bill splits evenly
cards.body: Six of you ate, you had the cheapest thing on the menu, and the table decides to split it evenly. Your share is £16.

options.label: Say what you actually had (£9)
options.outcome: You say it. It's slightly awkward and completely fine.

cards.title: Everyone's going
cards.body: Cinema Friday. £9.50 in, and nobody goes to the cinema without getting something.

options.label: Don't go
options.outcome: You stay in. It'll be streaming in four months.

cards.title: Saturday afternoon
cards.body: A few of you are going out Saturday afternoon. It's £11 in, plus the bus.

options.label: Give it a miss
options.outcome: You give it a miss. It's on again in a fortnight.

baking.title: Ice rink, Saturday
baking.body: A few of you are going to Dundonald on Saturday afternoon. £11 in with skate hire, plus £2.50 on the bus.

options.label: Go (£13.50)
options.outcome: Two and a half hours and you can't feel your ankles.

options.label: Give it a miss
options.outcome: You give it a miss. It's on again in a fortnight.

crochet.title: the roller rink, Saturday
crochet.body: A few of you are going to the roller rink on Saturday afternoon. £11 for the session, plus £2.50 on the bus.

options.label: Go (£13.50)
options.outcome: Two hours and one properly impressive fall.

options.label: Give it a miss
options.outcome: You give it a miss. It's on again in a fortnight.

cards.title: Someone's birthday
cards.body: It's a friend's birthday on Thursday and you've been invited to the thing. A present is expected, roughly.

options.label: Make something
options.outcome: You make something. It goes down better than the £20 would have.

cards.title: Can you lend me a tenner
cards.body: Your sister's short and asks for £10 until Saturday. She has form, both ways.

options.label: Lend it
options.outcome: Lent. She says Saturday.

options.label: Say no
options.outcome: You say no. It's fine, mostly.

cards.title: She's short at the till
cards.body: You're both at the till in the shop in Millbrook and she's £4 short. The queue is behind you.

options.label: Cover it (£4)
options.outcome: Covered. She'll get you back or she won't.

options.label: Let her put something back
options.outcome: She puts the second thing back. Nobody says anything.

cards.title: Missed the last bus
cards.body: You're in Eastport, it's twenty past ten, and the last one to Millbrook went at ten.

options.label: Ring home for a lift
options.outcome: You get a lift. There is a conversation in the car.

cards.title: The trainers, reduced
cards.body: The £75 ones are £52 until Sunday. Your current ones have another few months in them, probably.

options.label: Buy them (£52)
options.outcome: Bought. That's a real dent, and they're yours.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: You leave it. They're £75 again on Monday.

cards.title: Presale, 9am Thursday
cards.body: £48 a ticket and they will be gone by five past. Everyone is going. It's in March.

options.label: Buy a ticket (£48)
options.outcome: You're in. That is a lot of money in one go.

options.label: Sit this one out
options.outcome: You sit it out. The chat is unbearable for two days.

cards.title: Charity shop, High Street
cards.body: A jacket that is exactly right, £8, and it will not be there tomorrow.

options.label: Buy it (£8)
options.outcome: Bought. Genuinely good.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: You leave it. You think about it on Thursday.

cards.title: The thing you keep looking at
cards.body: £9.99. You've opened the page four times this week.

options.label: Close the tab
options.outcome: You close the tab. You open it again on Sunday.

baking.title: Kart Rush — the season pass
baking.body: New season, £9.99 for the pass. You've opened it four times this week and everyone you play with has already bought it.

options.label: Buy the pass (£9.99)
options.outcome: Bought. It's good for about six weeks.

options.label: Close the tab
options.outcome: You close the tab. You open it again on Sunday.

crochet.title: The hook set
crochet.body: The proper set with the soft handles, £9.99. Yours are fine. Yours also give you a sore hand after an hour.

options.label: Buy the set (£9.99)
options.outcome: Bought. Your hand stops aching by Thursday.

options.label: Close the tab
options.outcome: You close the tab. You open it again on Sunday.

cards.title: Collection tin, High Street
cards.body: Someone's standing outside with a tin as you're walking past. You've got change on you.

options.label: Keep walking
options.outcome: You keep walking.

cards.title: Coffee morning at church
cards.body: Saturday morning, tea and traybakes, all of it going to the appeal. Nobody's counting what anyone puts in.

options.label: Just have the tea
options.outcome: You just have the tea.

cards.title: A JustGiving link
cards.body: Someone from your year is doing a sponsored silence. The link is in the group chat and it's on 11%.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: You leave it.

cards.title: Harvest appeal
cards.body: The harvest collection is this Sunday and it's been announced three weeks running.

options.label: Nothing this time
options.outcome: Nothing this time.

cards.title: You're out of supplies
cards.body: You can't make anything else until you buy more. £12 for enough to do a batch.

options.label: Buy a batch (£12)
options.outcome: Bought. It's supplies, not stock — it doesn't sell itself.

options.label: Not this week
options.outcome: Not this week.

crochet.title: The Wool Shop have your shade in
crochet.body: High Street, and they're clearing the shade you actually wanted. £12 for enough to do a batch — and it won't be there next week.

options.label: Buy it (£12)
options.outcome: Bought. It's yarn, not finished things — it doesn't sell itself.

options.label: Not this week
options.outcome: Not this week. You think about it on the bus home.

baking.title: Out of everything that makes it look good
baking.body: You've flour and eggs. You've no colours, no sprinkles, and one piping nozzle that's split. £8 restocks the lot.

options.label: Restock (£8)
options.outcome: Bought. It's ingredients, not cakes — it doesn't sell itself.

options.label: Not this week
options.outcome: Not this week. Everything you make is beige.

cards.title: Stall fee
cards.body: The Christmas market wants £10 for a half table. It's on Saturday week, so you'd need stock ready.

options.label: Book the half table (£10)
options.outcome: Booked. Paid before a single thing has sold.

options.label: Not this year
options.outcome: Not this year.

cards.title: The perfume, and the one that's nearly it
cards.body: The one you actually want is £38. There's a dupe of it for £9 that people say is close.

options.label: The real one (£38)
options.outcome: Bought. It lasts months, and it's the one.

options.label: The dupe (£9)
options.outcome: It is close. It also goes off you by about two.

options.label: Neither
options.outcome: Neither. You still have most of the last one.

cards.title: The clips keep disappearing
cards.body: You're down to one good claw clip and two that don't hold. £14 for a proper set, or £3.50 for a multipack that'll also go missing.

options.label: The multipack (£3.50)
options.outcome: Bought. Three of them are gone inside a fortnight.

options.label: Manage with what you have
options.outcome: You manage. Mostly.

baking.title: The hair stuff, again
baking.body: Clips, claws, the scrunchies that actually hold. You had plenty in August and you can find four. £14 for the good set or £3.50 for the multipack that'll also vanish.

options.label: The proper set (£14)
options.outcome: Bought. These ones you will actually keep track of.

options.label: The multipack (£3.50)
options.outcome: Bought. Three of them are gone inside a fortnight.

options.label: Manage with what you have
options.outcome: You manage. Mostly.

cards.title: The earrings that go with everything
cards.body: £16, and you can see exactly where they'd work. You already own earrings.

options.label: Find a cheaper pair (£5)
options.outcome: Close enough. One of them turns your ear green by Thursday.

options.label: Leave them
options.outcome: You leave them. They're still there next week, which proves nothing either way.

cards.title: The one everyone's on about
cards.body: £17. The one you already use costs £5 and has never once let you down.

options.label: Try it (£17)
options.outcome: Bought. You'll know in three weeks whether it was the thing or the lighting.

options.label: Neither this month
options.outcome: Neither. You've enough to be going on with.

cards.title: You've run out of the boring one
cards.body: Not the exciting thing — the one you use every day and never think about. £6.50.

options.label: Use your sister's for now
options.outcome: You use your sister's. This will come up again, and she will remember.

cards.title: Bus or legs
cards.body: You're in Eastport and you're done for the day. The bus home to Millbrook is £1.75 each way. You could walk one leg of it — it's about forty minutes, and you'd get home when you get home.

options.label: Get the bus both ways (£3.50)
options.outcome: Home in ten minutes with the evening still in front of you.

options.label: Walk one leg, keep the £1.75
options.outcome: You keep £1.75. The forty minutes came out of tonight.

cards.title: The shortcut costs £9
cards.body: You could buy the ready-made version for £9 and be finished tonight, or do it yourself for nothing and lose an evening to it.

options.label: Buy the ready-made one (£9)
options.outcome: Done, and the evening is yours.

options.label: Make it yourself
options.outcome: It costs nothing. It costs an evening.

crochet.title: Wound or unwound
crochet.body: The Wool Shop on High Street has the same yarn in ready-wound cakes for £9, or in hanks for nothing extra — but a hank has to be wound before you can use a metre of it, and that's your evening gone.

options.label: Buy it ready-wound (£9)
options.outcome: You can start tonight. That's what the £9 bought.

options.label: Wind the hanks yourself
options.outcome: Free, and it takes the whole evening, and your arms ache.

baking.title: Ready-roll or make it
baking.body: The ready-to-roll icing is £9 for enough to cover the whole thing. Making it from scratch costs almost nothing and takes an evening on its own, before you've decorated anything.

options.label: Buy the ready-roll (£9)
options.outcome: Straight to the decorating. That's what the £9 bought.

options.label: Make it from scratch
options.outcome: Nearly free, and the evening went on icing you can't even see yet.

cards.title: Next day or Thursday
cards.body: What you've ordered can come next day for £5.95, or free and arrive Thursday. Thursday means starting later and working an evening you hadn't planned on.

options.label: Pay for next day (£5.95)
options.outcome: It lands tomorrow. You start when you meant to.

options.label: Take the free one
options.outcome: Free postage, and an evening later in the week goes on catching up.

cards.title: Greggs or the packed one
cards.body: Everyone's going to Greggs. It's £3.40 for the meal deal. There is a perfectly good lunch in your bag that you made last night.

options.label: Go with them (£3.40)
options.outcome: £3.40. You were going to eat either way.

options.label: Eat what you brought
options.outcome: You eat what you brought. They go anyway.

cards.title: The late bus
cards.body: You're out and the last bus that gets you home at a reasonable hour goes in twenty minutes. Stay on and you're walking part of it in the dark, or getting collected and owing someone a favour.

options.label: Leave now and get the bus (£1.75)
options.outcome: Home early. You missed the end of it.

options.label: Stay to the end
options.outcome: You stayed. It cost you tomorrow evening putting right what you didn't do tonight.

cards.title: Or listen to the ads
cards.body: The music subscription is £5.99 a month. The free one is the same music with an advert every four songs.

options.label: Pay for it (£5.99/mo)
options.outcome: It's a bill now. It comes every month whether you thought about it or not.

options.label: Put up with the ads
options.outcome: You put up with the ads. Roughly fifteen of them an hour.

cards.title: Fix it or replace it
cards.body: It's broken. A new one is £16. You could probably mend the old one — you've watched someone do it — but that's an evening and it might not work.

options.label: Buy a new one (£16)
options.outcome: New one. Sorted in four minutes.

options.label: Try to mend it
options.outcome: An evening on it. You'll know by the end whether that was £16 well saved.

cards.title: Five lunches at once
cards.body: An evening now makes the whole week's lunches for about £6 of shopping. Or you buy at school, around £3 a day, and keep the evening.

options.label: Make the week's lunches (£6)
options.outcome: £6 and one evening covers all five days.

options.label: Buy them at school (£15)
options.outcome: £15 across the week, and five evenings you didn't spend on it.

cards.title: Spending money for the trip
cards.body: The school trip is paid for. The letter says to bring spending money and suggests £10. Half your year will bring £20.

options.label: Take £20
options.outcome: You take £20. The gift shop does the rest.

options.label: Take £10
options.outcome: You take what the letter said.

options.label: Take £4 for a drink
options.outcome: You take £4. You spend £4.

cards.title: A card and something for Miss
cards.body: She's leaving at the end of the week. Someone is going round the class with an envelope.

options.label: Put in £5
options.outcome: £5 in the envelope.

options.label: Put in £2
options.outcome: £2 in the envelope. Nobody looks at the amounts.

options.label: Just sign the card
options.outcome: You sign the card.

cards.title: The bigger bag is cheaper
cards.body: The big pack is £30 and works out much cheaper per use. The small one is £12. You'd have to part with the £30 today.

options.label: Buy the big pack (£30)
options.outcome: The big pack. You are set for a good while.

options.label: Buy the small one (£12)
options.outcome: The small one. You'll be back for more.

crochet.title: Cotton by the cone
crochet.body: The Wool Shop have a big cone of cotton at £30 that works out at about half the price of the balls. The balls are £12 for enough to do a batch.

options.label: Buy the cone (£30)
options.outcome: The cone. You won't have to think about yarn for a while.

options.label: Buy the balls (£12)
options.outcome: The balls. You'll be back for more.

baking.title: The 5kg bag
baking.body: Good chocolate, in a 5kg bag, is £20 and works out much cheaper per bake. A small bar is £8 for a batch's worth.

options.label: Buy the 5kg bag (£20)
options.outcome: The big bag. It takes up half a shelf.

options.label: Buy the small bar (£8)
options.outcome: The small one. You'll be back for more.

cards.body: It's a one-off. It unlocks the thing you've been going without.

options.label: Buy it (£4.99)
options.outcome: Bought. It's a good thing to have.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: You leave it. It'll still be there.

crochet.title: The pattern
crochet.body: A pattern for the thing you've wanted to make since the summer. It's £4.99 as a PDF. You've seen the same thing done for free, badly.

options.label: Buy the pattern (£4.99)
options.outcome: Bought. The instructions make sense.

options.label: Work it out yourself
options.outcome: You work it out yourself. It takes longer.

baking.title: The skin
baking.body: A new kart skin on Kart Rush. £4.99. It makes no difference to how you drive.

options.label: Buy it (£4.99)
options.outcome: Bought. You look good for about a week.

options.label: Keep the default
options.outcome: You keep the default.

cards.title: Youth Club pizza night
cards.body: Pizza at Youth Club this Friday. £5 for the night, and it's a long one.

options.label: Pay for pizza (£5)
options.outcome: £5 and a slice and a half.

options.label: Bring your own (about £2)
options.outcome: You bring your own. People look at it, and then forget.

options.label: Skip the food
options.outcome: You skip the food and eat at home.

cards.title: Something to wear
cards.body: A wedding at church on Saturday and nothing in your wardrobe is right. A new dress is £35. There's one in a charity shop for £12.

options.label: Buy a new one (£35)
options.outcome: New. It fits properly.

options.label: Charity shop (£12)
options.outcome: £12. It needs taking in.

options.label: Borrow
options.outcome: You borrow one. It comes back on Monday.

cards.title: Escape room, six of you
cards.body: £14 each, an hour long, and somebody has already booked it. They need a yes by tonight.

options.label: You're in (£14)
options.outcome: £14. You get out with four minutes to spare.

options.label: You're out
options.outcome: You're out. They send you the photo afterwards.

cards.title: Things you've outgrown
cards.body: A bag of clothes and a few games you don't use. Listing them online would take an evening and bring in about £15. Or it can all go to the charity shop.

options.label: List them online (+£15)
options.outcome: Listed. Photos, descriptions, and replies at eleven at night.

options.label: Take it to the charity shop
options.outcome: You take the bag in. It's gone in two minutes.

cards.title: Babysitting on Saturday
cards.body: A family at church needs someone from six till eleven. £20, and the kids will be in bed by eight.

options.label: Say yes (+£20)
options.outcome: Yes. The kids are asleep by eight.

options.label: Say no
options.outcome: You say no. They ask someone else.

cards.title: The neighbours' dog
cards.body: The neighbours are away for three days and would pay £8 for an evening walk each day. It's an hour round the fields at Millbrook.

options.label: Say yes (+£8)
options.outcome: Yes. The dog is the easy part.

options.label: Say no
options.outcome: You say no.

cards.title: Still in the bag
cards.body: You bought it two weeks ago and haven't used it once. You can return it until Friday for the £14 you paid.

options.label: Take it back (+£14)
options.outcome: Returned. £14 back.

options.label: Keep it
options.outcome: You keep it. You'll use it.

cards.title: The free trial ends tomorrow
cards.body: It becomes £7.99 a month unless you cancel it. You've used it three times.

options.label: Keep it (£7.99/mo)
options.outcome: You keep it.

options.label: Cancel it
options.outcome: Cancelled. It takes four screens and a survey.

cards.title: The club hoodie
cards.body: Everyone is ordering one. £28, and it takes six weeks. There's a second-hand one from last year's lot for £10.

options.label: Order the new one (£28)
options.outcome: Ordered. It's six weeks away.

options.label: Take the second-hand one (£10)
options.outcome: £10. It smells of someone else's house for a week.

options.label: Neither
options.outcome: You don't order one.

cards.title: The costume for Saturday
cards.body: A party on Saturday and everyone's dressing up. Ready-made is £14. You could put one together from what's in the house.

options.label: Buy one (£14)
options.outcome: You buy one. It comes in a bag with a hat.

options.label: Put one together
options.outcome: It takes an evening. It's better than the one in the shop.

options.label: Go as yourself
options.outcome: You go as yourself.

cards.title: Christmas jumper day
cards.body: It's on Friday. £1 to the charity if you wear one. There's a new one in the shop for £16.

options.label: Buy a new one (£16)
options.outcome: New one. You'll wear it twice a year.

options.label: Wear last year's (£1)
options.outcome: Last year's. £1 into the tin.

options.label: Wear a normal jumper
options.outcome: A normal jumper. Nobody checks.

cards.title: The sales
cards.body: Everything's half price and half of it is things you already have. There's one thing you do want. £30, down from £60.

options.label: Buy it (£30)
options.outcome: Bought. It was £60 on Friday.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: You leave it. It will be £60 again in February.

cards.title: Results day
cards.body: You did better than you thought. Your friends are going for something to eat to mark it.

options.label: Go and eat properly (£12)
options.outcome: £12. It was worth it.

options.label: Just a snack (£4)
options.outcome: £4. You're home by six.

options.label: Go home
options.outcome: You go home and ring your gran.

cards.title: One side of the headphones
cards.body: The left side has gone. A good new pair is £40. A cheap pair is £12. Or you can listen in one ear.

options.label: Good ones (£40)
options.outcome: Good ones. They sound like different music.

options.label: Cheap ones (£12)
options.outcome: Cheap ones. They'll do for now.

options.label: One ear
options.outcome: One ear.

cards.title: School photo envelope
cards.body: The package you ordered is £12. Everyone else's came back in the envelope this morning.

options.label: Pay it (£12)
options.outcome: £12. It's not your best.

options.label: Don't order
options.outcome: You send the envelope back empty.

cards.title: Fares are going up
cards.body: The Millbrook to Eastport bus is going up. £2 more a week, from Monday.

cards.title: Non-uniform day
cards.body: It's £2 for the charity if you come in your own clothes. Most people do.

options.outcome: £2. You pick the jacket.

options.label: Wear uniform
options.outcome: You wear uniform.

cards.title: The poppy seller
cards.body: Outside the shop, in the cold, for hours. There's a tin and a tray.

options.label: Walk past
options.outcome: You walk past.

cards.title: Shoebox appeal
cards.body: Boxes go in at church this week. Soap, a toy, a hat, a pencil case. A full one is about £10 if you pick things carefully.

options.label: Fill a box (£10)
options.outcome: A box, wrapped, with a note.

options.label: Not this year
options.outcome: Not this year.

cards.title: Christmas cards
cards.body: A box of twenty, stamps for the ones that have to be posted. It comes to £6.

cards.title: Secret Santa
cards.body: £5 limit. You drew somebody you don't talk to much.

cards.title: Christmas money
cards.body: Cards open and £20 falls out of one from your gran. It's the only card with money in it.

cards.title: A tenner from Gran
cards.body: She presses it into your hand at the door and says it's not for anything in particular.

cards.title: She paid you back
cards.body: A message from last month. It's £6 and an apology, and you'd stopped counting on it.

cards.title: A voucher in a card
cards.body: £10 for somewhere you actually go. It has to be used by March.

cards.title: Lost property
cards.body: Your school jumper is not in lost property. It's not at home either. A new one is £14.

options.label: Buy a new one (£14)
options.outcome: £14. The new one is the wrong shade of blue.

options.label: Wear last year's
options.outcome: Last year's. The sleeves are short.

cards.title: Data's gone
cards.body: It's the 19th and your data ran out this morning. A top-up is £5.

options.label: Top up (£5)
options.outcome: Topped up.

options.label: Use wifi until the 1st
options.outcome: You use wifi until the 1st. It's a long fortnight.

cards.title: Cake sale at school
cards.body: It's for the charity the school picked. The cakes are £1 each, and half of them look homemade.

options.outcome: Three cakes. One is for later.
One cake.

options.label: Walk past
options.outcome: You walk past.

cards.title: A collection at church
cards.body: Someone's had a baby. There's an envelope going round after the service.

options.label: Sign the card
options.outcome: You sign the card.

cards.title: A table at the school fair
cards.body: The school Christmas fair has tables at £5. It's on Saturday and there'll be a lot of parents.

options.label: Book a table (£5)
options.outcome: Booked. Whatever you have by Saturday is what you've got.

options.label: Give it a miss
options.outcome: You give it a miss.

_time: Cards with `takesEvening` on an option consume one of the week's five evenings (spec §6). That is the only cost in the game a player feels rather than counts, so the cheap option is usually the one that carries it. the designer, 18 Sep: "buy something to save time, or save the money and take the time."
